reason: My Excel sheets, the whiteboard and Xero run the business fine and my team knows them; I'm not paying nearly $8,400 a year to a brand-new company with zero customers to replace something that works.
objection: Nobody is using it yet. If it falls over or the company folds mid excursion season, my bookings, rosters and driver records are stuck in someone else's system and I'm the one ringing schools to apologise.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another coach operator my size running on it for a full school season, plus a free trial outside my busy period with my data imported for me and a proper Xero link.
